title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Beer and Wine Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the delightful flavors of Niagara's best wines and craft beers on this guided half-day tour. Visit three award-winning wineries and Niagara's top brewery, sampling 12-16 different beverages while learning about the winemaking process from vine to glass. Enjoy a gourmet cheese and charcuterie pairing at one of the winery locations, enhancing your tasting experience. Perfect for wine lovers and beer enthusiasts alike, this tour includes roundtrip transportation in a comfortable mini bus, ensuring a relaxing afternoon in the beautiful Niagara Wine Country.

- Duration: 4 hours with convenient pickup times
- Enjoy tastings at three wineries and a brewery
- Learn from knowledgeable guides about wines and beers
- Savor gourmet cheese and charcuterie with your wines
